policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

method: Treat the objective GP implied by a proposed constraint scope as an independent candidate, using the later of the proposed constraint and active objective scope starts. Compare it with the retained incumbent on every subsequently purchased vector while the constraint proposal validates and no objective-specific head is installed. At constraint adoption, replace the objective GP only with at least four paired labels and the original two-standard-error gain criterion; a same-call adopted objective candidate also requires direct supporting comparison. Otherwise retain the incumbent GP and variance, keep the confirmed proposal pending, and continue comparisons on ordinary paid controls until support or objective-head installation. At an actual objective GP change, rebase the frozen objective candidate comparison using prepared direct evidence; historical advantage against the replaced model cannot authorize it.
selection: All153 existing paths with real constraint validation before objective-head installation, regardless of whether an objective candidate is frozen. This includes seven paths beyond the previous anticipatory-comparison inventory. Four previous no-entry controls are run again. The same fifteen development cases run before the complete historical and fresh batches.
reuse_rule: The replacement method is entered only for a constraint proposal being validated while no objective-specific head is installed. Reuse306 complete baseline paths without a corresponding pre-installation validation call; rerun four no-entry controls. Actual prior v0.48 references include already validated no-entry reuse. Reused paths are not newly executed trajectories.
accounting: 153 affected and4 control runs plus54 fresh paired runs cost6752 online calls. Fresh shared acquisition costs384 initial and1920 evaluator calls. Fifteen development runs cost480 online calls and are included once in the full budget. Each arm has32 initial and32 online calls. Record extra GP fits, training rows, prediction rows and elapsed fitting time separately. No new strict49, anticipatory49, vanilla or CodeAgent runs.
source_loading: Freeze all nine v0.48 intervention modules plus objective_replacement.py for the new method. Each arm uses its frozen module package and the unchanged shared support modules.
limitations: The existing463 include prior failed-method development and confirmation evidence. Report the predeclared fresh27 separately and execute them only after development is promising. Historical timing is not a simultaneous speed comparison. Missing measured objective evaluator labels remain missing; saved true means are used only for explicitly labelled true MSE.
